name: Active nematic stripe that flows only above a critical width
question: Is the sense of the spontaneous shear flow of a stripe inherited when the stripe divides below its critical width?
assumptions: the dimensionless parameters of the corrected Fig. 4 caption: K = gamma = zeta Dmu = eta = W_s = 1, nu = -2 (extensile, flow aligning; supercritical)
the achiral model: the cells of the source carry a chiral field that selects one tilt in more than 90% of stripes
growth of the width by uniform proliferation at the rate 0.05; division by a new edge with the same anchoring at 1.6 L_c
additive orientational noise of intensity 5e-4 per unit width

provenance.source: G. Duclos et al., Nat. Phys. 14, 728 (2018), Supplementary Note Eqs. 7-8 (Author Correction, Nat. Phys. 15, 868, 2019); after R. Voituriez, J.-F. Joanny and J. Prost, Europhys. Lett. 70, 404 (2005)
